name: Gaussian closure
domain: 车辆轨道结构与数值方法
definition_zh: 假定系统响应服从高斯分布以闭合统计矩方程的方法。
usage_note: 原文称强非线性系统下的PDF与高阶矩估计存在局限；与等效线性化的等价关系限定于纯加性激励。

complete_examples.text: Moment equations can be solved by introducing proper closure schemes, in which the Gaussian closure is the simplest one with the assumption that the distribution of response is Gaussian [3].

Therefore, a non-Gaussian closure method, named cumulant-neglect closure [8,9], was proposed to overcome this difficulty to solve the moment equations by making their hierarchy closed to a desired level.
